name: UI Manager
author: Brett
description: Select any UI element in the whole console and edit every property and token it reads, choosing from predetermined values the console and the framework supply (asset ids, enums, colour tokens, ranges): never free text where a list exists. Collapsible categories; 'On screen now' lists what is visible as shortcuts to the same element. Live preview, reset to skin / default, overrides shown, change log with undo. Core rules: framework/core/engines/ui-manager-rules.mjs (ui-element@1, ui-overrides@1, ui-change@1).

items.title: List selectable elements
items.description: Every UI element the UI Manager can select, with its category and how many overrides it carries. q = words, category = a category id, visible = ids on screen now.

items.title: Element tree
items.description: The collapsible categories. 'On screen now' lists shortcuts to the elements whose ids are passed as visible.

items.title: Properties and tokens of an element
items.description: The expanding row: every property and token with its value, base, source (override / skin / asset / default) and choices.

items.title: Valid values of a property
items.description: The predetermined values of one property: asset ids, enum words, colour tokens (@accent …), a range with a step. Never free text.

items.title: Set a property
items.description: Set one property of one element to one of its choices and save it (one change-log entry). Anything outside the list is refused with the valid values.

items.title: Reset to skin / default
items.description: Drop the override of one property, of one element, or of everything.

items.title: Live preview plan
items.description: CSS on tokens, asset swaps and patches for a pending overrides document (or the saved one), plus the exit summary (element, property, old → new).

items.title: Apply pending changes
items.description: Save a whole pending ui-overrides@1 document as one change-log entry; every value is checked against its choices first.

items.title: Change log
items.description: Every applied change: who, when, element, property, old → new; undone entries marked.

items.title: Undo a change
items.description: Put every property of one change-log entry back to its previous value.
